name: TIC 150393047

text.card: A red giant 1,115 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.85 solar masses and 11.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,907 K at its surface.
